text:
I fixed all six bugs I found in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no shell tool in this session, so I made the fixes by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes the missing `Emma` book (Austen, 1815, 1 copy).
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE`. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. The old import pointed at a module that doesn't exist.

I didn't modify any tests.
